findings.entity: Mirror reflection vs. real man's applicator stick
findings.description: In a continuous shot with no cut, the man's actual stick is pressed to his chin/lower lip (clearly below the mouth line in the profile view), while his mirror reflection at the same instant shows the white stick applied to the upper lip/philtrum, just below the nose. A real mirror must show the stick at the same facial position as the real action. The same vertical mismatch recurs at 0:06 (foreground stick at chin, reflection stick at upper lip). Additionally, at 0:00 the foreground stick reads as dark while the reflected stick is bright white, suggesting the reflection does not depict the same object state.
